correctness.rationale: The complete finite proof has a parity bijection with 32 cube odd-degree edge subgraphs and two independent graph-perfect-matching enumerations; exactly 118096 simplices follow. Sequential element pairings are acyclic by the element-pairing lemma and by explicit topological sorts of all 737700 Hasse incidences. The ascending pairing leaves one critical zero-cell and 11 degree-three and 11 degree-four cells with an exact integral Morse differential of determinant +1; descending order independently yields a 23-by-23 determinant +1. Hence the simply connected Morse CW complex is integral-acyclic and contractible. A separate matching-polynomial recurrence returns ordinary matching Euler characteristic -331. The standalone script reproduces the proof data and limits.

value.rationale: This is the complete perfect-matching homotopy classification of a canonical Archimedean cubic polyhedron, beyond the honeycomb/strip families of the motivating papers. Its non-cone 11-dimensional 118096-face complex is contractible even though the ordinary matching complex on the same graph is noncontractible by a large Euler-characteristic gap. The 32-facet odd-degree cube-subgraph parametrization and exact integer Morse cancellations give an interpretable benchmark, not an arbitrary slice or just a face count.
